abstract: Upwork's Q1 2026 results (May 7, 2026): gross services volume was about flat at $987.1M (-0.1%), revenue rose 1% to $195.5M, active clients fell 3% to 784,000, and GSV per active client rose 5% to $5,138. GSV from AI-related work grew more than 40% year over year and AI Integration & Automation more than 50%. CEO Hayden Brown described 'a challenging demand environment' as 'the nature of work continues to shift as AI advances.' Upwork announced a restructuring cutting about 24% of its total workforce, with $16–23M of pre-tax charges, and raised full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance.
keyFindings: GSV $987.1M, about flat (-0.1%) year over year; revenue $195.5M, up 1%.
GSV from AI-related work up more than 40% year over year; AI Integration & Automation up more than 50%.
Restructuring to cut about 24% of Upwork's own workforce.
methodology: Upwork Inc. Q1 2026 earnings press release with unaudited condensed statements and company-defined key metrics.
qualifiers: Tier 1 per repo convention for SEC-filer earnings releases. Single platform; no hourly rate disclosed. The 24% workforce reduction is Upwork's own staff, not freelancers on the platform. AI attribution is management commentary.
